mapper.select: SELECT id FROM tc_product WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND product_no=#{productNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE tc_product SET name=#{name},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{productId} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status<>'PUBLISHED'
UPDATE tc_sku SET unit_price=#{price},currency=#{currency},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND product_id=#{productId} ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
UPDATE tc_product SET status='PUBLISHED',published_revision=version+1,version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{productId} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status<>'PUBLISHED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tc_sku_revision(tenant_id,sku_id,revision,title,unit_price,currency,specification,stock_type) SELECT s.tenant_id,s.id,p.published_revision,p.name,s.unit_price,s.currency,s.specification,s.stock_type FROM tc_sku s JOIN tc_product p ON p.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND p.id=s.product_id WHERE p.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND p.id=#{productId}
mapper.update: UPDATE tc_product SET status='OFFLINE',version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{productId} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status='PUBLISHED'
mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS productId,s.id AS skuId,p.name AS name,p.status AS status,p.version AS version,s.unit_price AS unitPrice,s.currency AS currency,p.published_revision AS publishedRevision FROM tc_product p JOIN tc_sku s ON s.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND s.product_id=p.id WHERE p.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND p.id>#{after} AND (#{admin} OR p.status='PUBLISHED') AND s.id=(SELECT MIN(s2.id) FROM tc_sku s2 WHERE s2.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND s2.product_id=p.id) ORDER BY p.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.id AS productId,s.id AS skuId,p.name AS name,p.status AS status,p.version AS version,s.unit_price AS unitPrice,s.currency AS currency,p.published_revision AS publishedRevision FROM tc_product p JOIN tc_sku s ON s.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND s.product_id=p.id WHERE p.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND p.id=#{productId} AND (#{admin} OR p.status='PUBLISHED') AND s.id=(SELECT MIN(s2.id) FROM tc_sku s2 WHERE s2.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND s2.product_id=p.id)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tc_sku s JOIN tc_product p ON p.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND p.id=s.product_id WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND s.id=#{skuId} AND (#{published}=FALSE OR p.status='PUBLISHED')
SELECT version FROM tc_product WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{productId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE tc_product SET image_url=#{imageUrl,jdbcType=VARCHAR},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{product} AND version=#{version}
